scores.notes: Left shows the pit under a dark night sky lit by torches, with tall blue-grey cylindrical walls and no stairs. Right shows the pit in bright daylight, built of sandy stone with an internal staircase, a gate and palms at the rim. The night versus full daylight is the clearest conflict, and neither description asks for a change of time.
Peter in the left foreground (brazier courtyard) and Peter stepping from the boat on the right both have curly greying hair, a grey beard, a middle-aged weathered face and the same skin tone.
Both show a wooden boat with a mast on a dark, stormy sea at night, with the moon behind clouds and a rocky, hilly coast with buildings on the right.

Left shows the storm at night; right shows the rain easing as the descriptions ask. Both have a wooden boat with a mast on open water and a hilly coast with a village along the shore, so the place is compatible.
Daniel hauled from the pit (left) and Daniel before Belshazzar (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older face and the same blue cloak with a shoulder bag.

Both show tall curling teal water walls on each side of a sandy, rocky seabed path under a dim evening or night sky. Left has a storm and a fire glow while right is clearer twilight with cliffs on the far shore, but the layout of the place is compatible.
Daniel at the feast (left) and Daniel standing among the lions (right) share short grey hair, a grey beard, an older lean face, the same skin tone and the blue cloak with a bag.

Left places the boat in a narrow, calm stretch of water a few metres from a lakeside stone village and moored boats, with land close on both sides. Right shows the boat far out on open rough sea with only a distant mountainous coast, so the boat's position does not match for the same occasion.
Both show the same morning lakeshore: a pebbly beach with a fire, a wooden boat, a lake running into a valley between hills, and a white village on the right bank.
Both show a wooden boat with a torn sail on a dark stormy sea at night, with the moon in clouds and a hilly coast with a village and cypresses behind.
Daniel lowered at the pit (left) and Daniel at the feast (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, an older lean face, the same skin tone and the blue cloak with a shoulder bag.
Daniel at the feast (left) and the smaller Daniel among the lions (right) both have grey hair, a grey beard, an older thin face and the same blue cloak with a bag; nothing conflicts.
Peter in the courtyard foreground (left) and Peter lifting the lame man (right) both have curly dark hair greying at the temples, a grey beard and a middle-aged face, and carry a net and staff.

The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a shepherd's staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair and a full white beard, matching Moses striking the rock on the right.
Kneeling David at the anointing (left) and David dodging the spear (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair, slim builds and the same skin tone.
Both show curling green-teal water walls on a sandy shore, with a far shore of red cliffs and a walled hilltop city on the right.

Both show tall curling teal water walls over a rocky, sandy seabed under a stormy sky with radiant light at the center. Left also shows the far shore's cliffs and city, which the wall hides in the right view, so the views are compatible.

Left shows the storm easing at dusk and right the storm at night, which the descriptions ask for. Both have a wooden boat with a torn sail on open water near a hilly coast with buildings, so the place matches.

The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair, a full white beard and a brown cloak, matching Moses with the raised rod on the right.
Moses seated with raised arms (left) and Moses leading through the sea (right) are both elderly men with white hair and long white beards, the same face shape and skin tone.
David at the stream (left) and kneeling David at the anointing (right) are both clean-shaven teenagers with short dark curly hair and a slim build.
Kneeling David (left) and David releasing the sling (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair and a slim build, wearing a similar brown tunic and bag.

Peter is clear on the left: greying curly hair and grey beard, lifting the lame man. The right description names no one, only several disciples and fishermen on the shore, so I cannot single out Peter there.

Jesus on the water (left) has long dark hair and a dark beard. Jesus on the cross (right) is small and his head is bowed, but he shows the same long dark hair, dark beard and slim face, and nothing conflicts.
Jesus on the cross (left, small) and Jesus on the water (right) both have long dark hair parted in the middle, a dark full beard and a slim face.
David slinging the stone (left) and kneeling David at the anointing (right, head bowed) both have short dark curly hair, a clean-shaven youthful face and a slim build.

The left description does not name Moses, so I identified him as the elderly man with a staff beside Aaron. He has long white hair and a long white beard, matching the seated Moses with raised arms on the right.
Both show curling teal water walls by a sandy shore, with red cliffs and a walled hilltop city on the far shore. The parting stage and the sky differ, but the place matches.
Both show the sea splitting into tall curling teal walls under a dark stormy sky with a fiery golden glow at the center, above a sandy, rocky shore and seabed.
Daniel in the pit centre-left (left) and centre of the den (right): same lean older face, short grey hair, short grey beard, blue robe over white tunic with shoulder satchel.
Kneeling youth under Samuel's horn (left) vs crouching youth at stream (right): both young, clean-shaven, short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic.
Foreground Peter by the brazier (left) vs Peter lifting the lame man (right): both middle-aged with curly dark-grey hair and grey-streaked full beard, net over shoulder.
Daniel standing among lions (left) vs Daniel gazing up at the fiery throne (right): same short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, lean face, blue robe and satchel strap.
Jesus at the tomb mouth (left) vs Jesus on the central cross (right, small but face visible): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.
Daniel in the den (left) vs Daniel before Belshazzar (right, large): same short grey hair, short grey beard, lean older face, blue robe over white tunic.
Youth slinging at Goliath (left) vs youth choosing stones (right): both clean-shaven teens with short dark curly hair, slim build, brown ragged tunic and bag.
Daniel before Belshazzar (left) vs Daniel hauled from the den (right): same grey cropped hair, short grey beard, lean face, blue robe with white tunic.
Crouching youth at stream (left) vs youth dodging Saul's spear (right): both clean-shaven, young, short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic.
Left Moses at the rock shows a long white beard and hair, but right Moses is seen from behind facing the sea, face hidden; only white hair is visible, so identity cannot be confirmed.
Peter steadying the lame man (left) vs Peter stepping onto water (right): curly dark-grey hair, grey-streaked beard, weathered middle-aged face, net over shoulder and staff in both.

Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; the foreground net-carrier with grey curly hair and beard resembles right-side Peter, but the subject cannot be identified from the text.
Jesus on the water (left) vs Jesus at the tomb (right): same long dark hair, dark full beard, long face, white tunic with dark blue mantle.
Moses at the rock (left, small but face visible) vs Moses seated on the hill (right): long white hair, long white beard, elderly, brown cloak and staff in both.
Peter leaping ashore (left) vs Peter lifting the lame man (right): curly grey-streaked hair, grey beard, broad weathered middle-aged face in both.
Right description is about Aaron and never names Moses; a white-bearded elder with staff stands beside Aaron and resembles left Moses, but the text does not single him out as Moses.
Youth dodging Saul's spear (left) vs youth choosing stones (right): clean-shaven teen with short dark curly hair, slim build, brown tunic in both.
Jesus on the cross (left, small) vs Jesus at the tomb (right): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.

Both show the dry sandy sea floor between tall green-teal wave walls under a stormy sky with a crowd receding down the corridor; the right adds red cliffs on the far shore, compatible with a different viewpoint.
Jesus at the tomb (left) vs Jesus standing in the boat stern (right): same long dark hair, dark beard, white tunic and dark blue mantle.

Both show a sandy dry corridor between towering dark-green water walls receding to the horizon under a cloudy sky; left adds red cliffs and palms at the shore, otherwise compatible from a different angle.
Peter leaping ashore (left) vs Peter stepping onto the water (right): curly dark-grey hair, grey-streaked beard, weathered middle-aged face.
Jesus on the cross (left) vs Jesus standing in the boat (right): long dark hair and dark beard in both, no conflicting cue.
Daniel gazing at the fiery throne (left) vs Daniel before Belshazzar (right): short grey hair, trimmed grey beard, lean face, blue robe over white tunic.
Jesus in the boat stern (left) vs Jesus on the waves (right): same long dark hair, dark beard, white tunic with blue mantle.
Moses at the sea (left, large) vs Moses at the rock (right, small but face visible): long white hair, long white beard, elderly, brown cloak and staff.

Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; a net-carrying man with grey curly hair and beard by the boat resembles right Peter, but the subject is not identified by the text.
Right description concerns Aaron and the pig and never names Moses; a white-bearded elder with staff beside Aaron resembles seated left Moses, but the text does not single him out.
Left description only says 'disciples' and does not single out Peter; the net-carrying grey-bearded man by the boat resembles right Peter on the water, but the subject is not identified by the text.
Jesus at the tomb (left, arm raised) and Jesus on the waves (right) both have long dark wavy hair, a full dark beard, a similar adult face and a cream tunic under a blue-grey cloak.

Daniel standing among the lions (left) and Daniel being lifted out (right) are both older men with short grey hair, a short grey beard and a slim build, in the same blue robe with a shoulder pouch. The left face is a little darker, with a thinner hairline, under night light, but that is not a clear conflict.
Jesus on the water (left) and Jesus standing in the stern (right) have the same long dark hair, full dark beard and adult face, in a cream tunic and blue cloak.

Both show tall dark-green walls of water on either side of a sandy, rocky seabed under storm cloud with a fiery glow in the centre. The right adds Moses on the shore and red cliffs, and these fit the left's view down the channel.

Both show curling teal water walls, a sandy, cracked seabed and red cliffs on the far shore (with a town on the left image, palms on the right). The left is darker with storm cloud from the wind it describes, but the place itself matches.

Both pits have round stone-block walls, but the left is shallow (the rim reaches roughly Daniel's shoulders, with daylight, palms and an iron fence beyond), while the right is a deep pit with walls several times his height, a dark night sky and torches.

Daniel being lifted out (left) has short grey hair, a grey beard and an older face, in a blue robe over a cream tunic with a pouch. The small, upward-gazing Daniel on the right matches in grey hair and beard, age and outfit, although his face is small and in shadow.
Moses at the sea (left, seen mostly from behind but showing a profile) and the seated Moses on the hill (right) are both very old men with long white hair and a long full white beard.
Peter stepping from the boat (left) and Peter lifting the lame man (right) share curly dark hair with grey, a grey-streaked full beard, a middle-aged weathered face and a net over the shoulder.

Both show a dirt road with dry-stone walls, olive groves, cypresses and a white village on rolling hills in golden light. The left also shows a lake in the distance that the right's angle leaves out, and nothing conflicts.
Jesus at the tomb (left) and Jesus in the boat's stern (right) both have long dark hair, a dark beard and a narrow face, in a cream tunic and blue-grey cloak.
Peter by the brazier (left) and Peter stepping onto the water (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a full grey-streaked beard and a middle-aged face, with a net over the shoulder and a staff.

The left description names only unnamed disciples and fishermen, not Peter, so no figure is singled out. A grey-bearded man with a net and staff beside the boat does resemble the right's Peter at the brazier.
Peter leaping from the boat clutching his coat (left) and Peter at the brazier (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a grey-streaked full beard and the same broad middle-aged face.

Both versions of Daniel have short grey hair and a grey beard, but the Daniel before Belshazzar (left) has light olive skin and a trimmed beard. The Daniel on the rooftop (right) has distinctly deep-brown skin and a fuller beard, while his cream tunic stays light, so the skin difference is not just shadow.

The small Daniel under the fiery throne (left) and Daniel in the den (right) both have grey hair, a grey beard, an older face and darkish skin, in the same blue robe with a pouch. The left figure is small, which limits detail.
The seated Moses supported by Aaron and Hur (left) and Moses leading the people through the sea (right) are both very old men with long white hair and a long flowing white beard.

Both show dry-stone walls, olive trees, terraced hills, a village and the same white columned temple on a hillside in warm light. The left adds a lake that the courtyard angle on the right does not show.
Peter at the brazier (left) and Peter leaping from the boat (right) both have curly dark-grey hair, a grey-streaked full beard and the same middle-aged face.
The left description names only Aaron and a crowd, so Moses is not singled out. An old man with white hair and a white beard holding a staff there does resemble the right's Moses.

The right description names only unnamed disciples and fishermen, not Peter. A grey-bearded figure with a net and staff on the shore resembles the left's Peter at the brazier, but the text does not identify him.
David at the stream (left) and David slinging the stone (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short curly dark hair and a slim build, in a rough brown tunic.
Moses at the sea (left, seen from behind and in profile) and Moses leading the people through (right) both have long white hair, a long white beard and very old age.
The kneeling David being anointed (left, head bowed) and David dodging Saul's spear (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short curly dark hair, in a brown tunic.

Both show a rural edge of olive groves, cypresses, dry-stone walls, a stone path or road and white houses on hills in golden evening light. The right's view also takes in a lake, and nothing conflicts.
Moses stretching his hand over the sea (left) and Moses leading the crossing (right) both have long white hair, a long white beard and very old age, in a cream tunic and brown cloak with a crook.
David slinging (left) and David choosing stones (right) are both beardless youths with short curly dark hair, in a rough brown tunic.

Both show the same kind of wooden boat with a single mast, a torn sail and a lantern, on a choppy lake with a village and hills on the shore. Storm and rain on the left giving way to clearing sky on the right is the change the descriptions ask for.
David dodging Saul's spear (left) and David choosing stones (right) are both clean-shaven youths with short curly dark hair and rosy cheeks, in a brown tunic.
Left: the young man dodging the spear by the lyre; right: the slinger. Both are clean-shaven youths with short dark curly hair, slim build and tanned skin.

Left: the leader with a staff walking between the water walls; right: the seated figure whose arms are held up. Both are elderly men with white shoulder-length hair and full white beards, and similar lined faces.
Left: the small figure raising a rod at the rock beside the ephod-wearer; right: the leader with a staff at the front of the crowd. Both are elderly men with white hair and white beards.

Left: the man on the rooftop gazing up at the fire; right: the man in the den. Both have short grey receding hair, a short grey beard, brown skin, a blue robe over a white tunic and a shoulder satchel.

Left: Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded elder raising a rod at the rock. The right description names Aaron and the crowd but not Moses, so no figure is singled out as him; the white-bearded elder with a staff beside Aaron resembles the left Moses.
Left: the figure standing in the stern; right: the figure standing on the waves. Both have long dark-brown hair, a full beard, a slim face, and a white tunic under a blue-grey robe.

Left: Peter is the curly grey-haired, grey-bearded man leaping ashore with his coat. The right description names only unnamed disciples, so none is singled out as Peter; the grey-bearded man with net and staff at the front resembles him.
Left: the figure on the water; right: the figure at the tomb entrance. Both have long dark-brown hair, a full beard, and a white tunic with a blue-grey robe.

Both show a single-masted wooden fishing boat on the Sea of Galilee under dark storm clouds, with a hilly shore and a village on the left. The calmer water on the left matches its description of the rain easing.

Both show a masted wooden boat in rough night water under rain and dark clouds with moonlight, and a hilly shoreline with village buildings. The village is on the left in one and on the right in the other, which fits a different viewpoint.
Left: the figure standing in the boat; right: the figure calling at the tomb. Both have long dark hair, a full dark beard, and a white tunic under a dark blue robe.
Both show a calm lake in morning light with a pebbly beach, a beached wooden boat, a charcoal fire, and a hillside village of stone houses with palms on the right.
Left: the man stepping from the boat onto the water; right: the man leaping ashore. Both have short curly grey hair, a short grey beard and a weathered middle-aged face.
Left: the figure on the central cross; right: the figure standing in the boat. Both have long dark hair and a dark beard. The crucified figure is small but legible.

Left: Peter is the dark curly-haired, grey-bearded man with a staff by the brazier. The right description names only unnamed disciples, so none is singled out as Peter; the grey-bearded man with net and staff at the centre resembles him.

Left: Peter is the curly grey-haired, grey-bearded man stepping onto the water. The right description names only unnamed disciples, so none is singled out as Peter; the grey-bearded man with net and staff at the centre resembles him.
Left: the figure standing in the boat; right: the figure on the cross. Both have long dark hair and a dark beard.
Left: the man stepping onto the water; right: the man lifting the lame man. Both have short curly grey-streaked hair, a grey beard and a broad weathered face.
Left: the man with a staff by the brazier; right: the man leaping ashore. Both have short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a grey beard and a broad weathered middle-aged face.

Right: Moses is the white-haired, long white-bearded leader with a crook between the water walls. The left description names Aaron and the crowd but not Moses, so no figure is singled out as him; the white-bearded elder with a crook beside Aaron resembles the right Moses.
Left: the man lifting the lame man; right: the man leaping ashore. Both have short curly grey-streaked hair, a grey beard and similar face and build.
Left: the man with a staff stepping onto the water; right: the man by the brazier. Both have short dark curly hair with grey, a grey-streaked beard and a lean weathered face.

Left: Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded man seen mostly from behind at the shore. The right description names Aaron and the crowd but not Moses, so no figure is singled out as him; the white-bearded elder with a crook beside Aaron resembles him.
Left: the man being hauled up the den; right: the small rooftop figure gazing at the fire. Both have short grey hair, a grey beard, brown skin, and a blue robe over a white tunic with a satchel.
Left: the seated figure with raised arms; right: the figure raising the rod at the rock. Both are elderly men with white hair and long white beards.

Right: Moses is the white-haired, white-bearded leader with a crook at the parted sea. The left description names Aaron and the crowd but not Moses, so no figure is singled out as him; the white-bearded elder with a crook beside Aaron resembles the right Moses.
Left: the man standing among the lions; right: the man being hauled up. Both have short grey hair, a grey beard, brown skin, and a blue robe over a white tunic with a satchel.
Left: the figure calling at the tomb; right: the figure on the cross. Both have long dark-brown hair and a dark beard. The crucified figure is small but legible.

Left: Peter is the curly grey-haired, grey-bearded man stepping from the boat. The right description names only unnamed disciples, so none is singled out as Peter; the bearded man with net and staff on the left of the group resembles him.
Peter stepping from the boat at night (left) and Peter leaping from the boat (right) both have short curly grey hair, a full grey beard, a weathered middle-aged face and a similar build.

Right text does not name Peter, but its lead disciple with a staff and a net over his shoulder matches left Peter: curly grey-dark hair, grey beard, same age and build. No other figure on the right resembles him.
Left text does not name Moses, but the elder with a staff beside Aaron has white wavy hair, a long white beard and an aged face, which match seated Moses on the right.
Moses striking the rock (left) and Moses at the sea (right) are both elderly, with wild white hair, a long white beard and a lean face.

Both show a lake shore with hills behind, stone village houses up the slope, a rocky beach and a fishing boat with a charcoal fire. The left is a long view down the lake, the right a closer view, and both are daylight morning scenes.

Left Moses crossing the sea has distinctly dark brown skin on his face and hands, swept-back white hair and a gaunt face. Right text does not name Moses, but its staff-bearing elder beside Aaron has lighter olive skin and a fuller face. The skin tone conflicts.

Left shows a deep, wide open-topped cylindrical stone pit under a dark night sky lit by torches. Right shows a ground-level stone pit with a wooden lid and an iron grate gate, in bright daylight with palms. Both the light and the structure conflict.
Seated Moses (left) and Moses at the rock (right) both have white wavy hair, a long white beard, an elderly face and a lean build.
Moses leading through the sea (left) and Moses at the rock (right) both have white hair, a long white beard and an elderly lean face, in the same brown cloak.
Jesus on the cross (left) and Jesus on the water (right) both have long dark-brown hair, a dark beard and a similar narrow face. The head on the left is bowed but readable.
Left text does not name Peter, but its lead fisherman with a staff and net has curly grey-dark hair and a grey beard, which match the leaping Peter on the right.
Peter at the temple gate (left) and Peter by the brazier (right) both have dark curly hair going grey, a grey-flecked beard and a middle-aged face.
Daniel on the rooftop (left) and in the den (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, dark brown skin, an older face and the same blue robe.
Left Moses has noticeably dark brown skin, a gaunt long face, swept-back hair and a trimmed beard. Right Moses has lighter olive skin, wavy white hair and a fuller beard. The skin tone conflicts.
Seated Moses (left) and Moses at the sea (right) both have light olive skin, wavy white hair, a full white beard and an elderly face.
Peter lifting the lame man (left) and leaping from the boat (right) both have curly grey hair, a grey beard and a weathered middle-aged face.
David at the stream (left) and kneeling David (right) are both clean-shaven teenagers with dark curly hair, rosy cheeks and a slim build.
Daniel before Belshazzar (left) and the small Daniel looking up (right) both have short grey hair, a grey beard and brown skin, in a blue robe. The right figure is small but these cues are readable.
David with the sling (left) and David by the lyre (right) are both beardless youths with dark curly hair and a slim build.
Both show the same wooden sailing boat with a torn sail and an oil lamp on a lake ringed by hills with a shoreline village. The calmer water on the right is the change the text asks for.
David dodging the spear (left) and kneeling David (right) are both beardless youths with dark curly hair, the same face and a slim build.
Moses at the sea (left) and Moses at the rock (right) both have long white hair, a long white beard, an elderly lean face and light skin.
Moses at the sea (left) and seated Moses (right) both have white wild hair, a long white beard and an elderly face.
David with the sling (left) and David dodging the spear (right) are both beardless youths with short dark curly hair and a similar face and build.
Kneeling David (left) and David with the sling (right) are both beardless youths with dark curly hair, rosy cheeks and a slim build.
